options_setup_intro.message: This add-on connects using a HubSpot access token, not a sign-in button. Here's why on the project page. HubSpot currently recommends creating a Service Key for integrations like this one; an existing private app token still works exactly the same way, so keep using it if you already have one.

options_credential_warning.message: Don't use a HubSpot “personal access key.” That's a different credential for the HubSpot CLI, limited to your own user permissions, and it isn't meant to be shared with an app like this one.

options_step1.message: New key: in HubSpot go to Development → Keys → Service keys → Create service key. Already have a private app? Settings → Integrations → Private Apps still works — use its token below instead.

options_step2.message: Add only the scopes below for the features you want, then finish creating the key.

options_step3.message: Copy the token into the field below and press Test connection.

options_scope_contacts_read_desc.message: Looking anyone up, and calls/meetings/notes in Recent activity — required

options_scope_sales_email_read_desc.message: Logging messages, and emails in Recent activity

options_token_label.message: HubSpot access token (Service Key or private app)

options_token_help.message: Works with either a Service Key or a private app access token — both use this same format. Stored locally in Thunderbird. Never sent anywhere except api.hubapi.com.

options_portal_id_help.message: Used to build "Open in HubSpot" links. Find it under Settings → Account Setup → Account Defaults.

options_bcc_help.message: Settings → Objects → Activities → Email Log & Track tab → Manual Logging → BCC Address → Copy. Lets the compose panel add it in one click.

options_never_log_help.message: One address or domain per line, e.g. person@example.com or example.com. These are never looked up or logged.

options_test_success.message: Connected as $NAME$. Contact read access is working.

options_test_success_generic.message: Connected successfully. Contact read access is working.

options_privacy_note.message: No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party servers. All requests go straight from this device to api.hubapi.com.
